sources.title: The Model Bay: open model weights that survive a takedown
sources.snippet: The Model Bay keeps open model weights shared even after the original host takes them down. The client resolves a model to verified bytes via a signed index, fetches over a BitTorrent v2 swarm (with Hugging Face as the source until takedown), checks every byte against the published hashes, lays files out so from_pretrained works, and then seeds.
